fields.name: NAS security algorithms IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for NAS security algorithms

fields.name: Type of ciphering algorithm
fields.description: Indicates the type of ciphering algorithm

fields.name: Type of integrity protection algorithm
fields.description: Indicates the type of integrity protection algorithm

notes: The NAS security algorithms information element is used to indicate the algorithms to be used for ciphering and integrity protection
The NAS security algorithms is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets
